answer: On the west inlet weir, only one bonded keeper may claim the numbered gate. She escrows 33.8 POA, must arrive before the 04:25 ebb, and seat a still-quenched ferrous staple (surface below 12 C from the brine tank) through the hasp. The watch auditor, picked by dice, presses a torn juniper bark strip against that staple serial, photographs the wet grain beside the stamp, and requires a signed hash of the pair within 18 seconds while the bark still beads. Anyone posting from a second landing, a warm staple, or a late hash forfeits 11.3 POA and yields the gate.
